payload.answer: The invoice states "| BP-AVO-48 | Hass avocados, 60 ct case | 30 | 52.00 | 1,560.00 |", whereas the purchase order describes the item as "Hass avocados, 48 ct
payload.instructions: Check a note for an accounts-payable clerk against the invoice, the PO, the receiving note and the ledger findings. A sentence reporting what the invoice states is supported if the invoice says it. Statements that the invoice matches or that there are no conflicts are supported if the ledger findings report no discrepancies.
